The IMF (October 2026 Asia-Pacific outlook) expects India's nominal GDP to pass Japan's in 2027, becoming the world's fourth-largest economy.
债务压力：IMF《财政监测报告》称全球公共债务 2025 年约为 GDP 的 9: Debt pressure: the IMF's Fiscal Monitor puts global public debt at about 94% of GDP in 2025, nearing 100% by 2029. The long-term outlook from the US Congressional Budget Office (CBO) in early 2026 shows federal debt held by the public rising from about 99% in fiscal 2025 to 108% in 2030, 129% in 2040 and about 175% in 2056, with net interest passing Social Security spending around 2047.
美国社会保障 2026 年受托人报告：老年与遗属保险（OASI）信托基金预计在: The 2026 US Social Security Trustees Report: the Old-Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI) trust fund is expected to run out in the fourth quarter of 2032, when continuing income could pay about 78% of scheduled benefits. OASI and Disability Insurance combined run out around the third quarter of 2034, paying about 83%. The 75-year actuarial deficit is 4.42% of taxable payroll.
贫困：世界银行 2025 年把国际极端贫困线上调至每天 3.00 美元（2021: Poverty: in 2025 the World Bank raised the international extreme poverty line to US$3.00 a day (2021 PPP), estimating about 808 million people (9.9%) in extreme poverty in 2025, with sub-Saharan Africa's share expected to rise from about 69% to about 73%. On the earlier US$2.15 measure, its 2024 report expected about 622 million (7.3%) still in extreme poverty in 2030, making the goal of ending it by 2030 almost out of reach.
不平等：《世界不平等报告 2026》显示，全球收入最高的 10% 人口获得约 5: Inequality: the World Inequality Report 2026 shows the top 10% of earners worldwide get about 53% of income and hold about three quarters of wealth, while the bottom 50% get only about 8% of income and hold about 2% of wealth.
就业：国际劳工组织《就业和社会趋势 2026》预计 2026 年全球失业率约 4: Jobs: the ILO's World Employment and Social Outlook 2026 forecasts global unemployment of about 4.9% in 2026 (about 186 million), with about 2.1 billion informal workers, the share highest in Africa and South Asia. Improvement in job quality has stalled.
劳动年龄人口格局转移：世界银行估计到 2050 年撒哈拉以南非洲将新增约 6.2: The shifting working-age population: the World Bank estimates sub-Saharan Africa will add about 625 million working-age people by 2050, over three quarters of the global rise, while East Asia and the Pacific lose over 200 million. The IMF estimates about half of new global labour market entrants by 2030 will come from sub-Saharan Africa, which may need up to about 15 million new jobs a year.
退休年龄普遍上调：中国自 2025 年 1 月起用 15 年时间将男职工法定退休: Retirement ages rising widely: China from January 2025 will raise the legal age over 15 years from 60 to 63 for men and from 50/55 to 55/58 for women, with the minimum pension contribution period rising by half a year annually from 15 to 20 years from 2030. Denmark legislated in 2025 to raise the state pension age to 68 in 2030, 69 in 2035 and 70 in 2040. Singapore raised its retirement/re-employment ages to 64/69 in July 2026, planning 65/70 by 2030. Vietnam reaches 62 for men in 2028 and 60 for women in 2035. Germany's legal age rises to 67 by 2031.
养老金改革进展：韩国 2025 年修订《国民年金法》，自 2026 年起缴费率每: Pension reform progress: South Korea's 2025 National Pension Act raises contributions by 0.5 points a year from 2026, from 9% to 13% in 2033, sets a nominal replacement rate of 43%, and delays the fund's depletion from 2056 to 2064 (2071 on optimistic assumptions). France's 2026 social security financing act suspends the 2023 retirement age rise until 2028. Britain's state pension age rises from 66 to 67 in 2026–2028. Russia completes its move to 65 for men and 60 for women in 2028.
观测：世界气象组织（WMO）报告 2024 年为有记录以来最暖年份，全球平均气温: Observations: the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) reports 2024 as the warmest year on record, about 1.55°C above pre-industrial (1850–1900), the first single year above 1.5°C. 2025 was about 1.43°C above, the second or third warmest, and 2015–2025 are the 11 warmest years on record.
WMO 与英国气象局 2026 年 5 月年度至十年气候预测：2026—2030: The WMO and UK Met Office's May 2026 annual-to-decadal climate update: a chance of about 91% that at least one year from 2026 to 2030 exceeds 1.5°C above pre-industrial, about 75% that the five-year average does, and about 86% that at least one year beats the 2024 record. Annual temperatures are expected at 1.3–1.9°C above pre-industrial.
升温路径：联合国环境署《排放差距报告 2025》估计，按现行政策本世纪升温约 2: Warming pathways: UNEP's Emissions Gap Report 2025 estimates about 2.8°C of warming this century under current policies, about 2.3–2.5°C with national pledges fully met, and about 1.9°C with all net-zero pledges too. In the IEA's World Energy Outlook 2025, the Current Policies Scenario nears 3°C by 2100, the Stated Policies Scenario reaches about 2.5°C, and the Net Zero Scenario peaks at about 1.65°C around 2050.
IPCC 第六次评估报告：2081—2100 年相对 1850—1900 年的升: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report: best estimates (very likely range) of warming in 2081–2100 relative to 1850–1900 are about 1.4°C (1.0–1.8) for SSP1-1.9, about 1.8°C (1.3–2.4) for SSP1-2.6, about 2.7°C (2.1–3.5) for SSP2-4.5, about 3.6°C (2.8–4.6) for SSP3-7.0 and about 4.4°C (3.3–5.7) for SSP5-8.5. In the near term (2021–2040), even very low emissions (SSP1-1.9) give over an even chance of reaching 1.5°C, and intermediate to high emissions likely or very likely exceed it.
IPCC 第六次评估报告：相对 1995—2014 年，全球平均海平面到 205: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report: relative to 1995–2014, global mean sea level is likely to rise 0.15–0.30 m by 2050. By 2100 the likely rise is 0.32–0.62 m for SSP1-2.6, 0.44–0.76 m for SSP2-4.5 and 0.63–1.01 m for SSP5-8.5. Ice sheet processes are uncertain, and nearly 2 m under high emissions can't be ruled out. By 2100, extreme sea levels once seen every hundred years may occur every year at over half of tide gauges.
沿海暴露：Kulp 与 Strauss（2019）基于新高程数据估计，目前约 1: Coastal exposure: Kulp and Strauss (2019), using new elevation data, estimate about 110 million people now live on land below the current high tide line. Under low emissions about 190 million live below projected high tide by 2100. Under high emissions up to about 340 million by mid-century and up to about 630 million by 2100 live below annual flood levels. The World Bank's Groundswell report estimates up to about 216 million internal climate migrants across six regions by 2050 without action.
高温对健康与劳动的影响：《柳叶刀倒计时》2025 年报告估计 2012—2021: Heat's effect on health and work: the Lancet Countdown 2025 report estimates about 546,000 heat-related deaths a year worldwide in 2012–2021, about 63% more than in the 1990s. A 2024 ILO report estimates about 2.4 billion workers (about 71%) are exposed to excessive heat at work, linked to about 22.85 million injuries and about 19,000 deaths a year, with exposure highest in Africa and Arab states.
极端事件与生态：IPCC 评估认为过去五十年一遇的极端高温在升温 1.5°C 时: Extremes and ecology: the IPCC assesses that heat extremes once seen every fifty years become about 8.6 times as frequent as pre-industrial at 1.5°C, about 13.9 times at 2°C and about 39.2 times at 4°C. The Global Tipping Points Report 2025 finds warm-water coral reefs have passed their thermal tipping point (central estimate about 1.2°C). An IPCC special report estimates coral reefs decline 70–90% at 1.5°C and over 99% at 2°C. Jägermeyr et al. (2021) estimate global maize yields may fall about 24% by the end of the century under high emissions, with effects appearing around 2030.
国际能源署《世界能源展望 2025》：在恢复使用的现行政策情景中，石油和天然气需: IEA World Energy Outlook 2025: in the revived Current Policies Scenario, oil and gas demand keep growing to mid-century, with oil at about 113 million barrels a day in 2050, and coal begins falling before 2030. In the Stated Policies Scenario oil demand levels off around 2030. About 730 million people still have no electricity and nearly 2 billion rely on polluting cooking. Under Stated Policies peak power demand grows about 40% by 2035, mainly from cooling. Data centres and AI make up under 10% of global power demand growth.
电力转型：Ember《全球电力评论 2026》显示，2025 年可再生能源发电占: The power transition: Ember's Global Electricity Review 2026 shows renewables made 33.8% of global power in 2025, passing coal (33.0%) for the first time. Solar reached about 2,778 TWh, up about 30%, solar and wind met almost all new demand, and fossil generation failed to grow for the first time since 2020. Fossil generation fell in both China and India, and wind and solar made up about 22% in China.
国际能源署：2025 年全球电动汽车销量超过 2000 万辆，约占全球新车销量: IEA: global electric car sales passed 20 million in 2025, about 25% of new cars worldwide and nearly 55% in China. It expects about 23 million in 2026, about 28%, partly from consumer and policy responses to the energy crisis. Renewables 2025 expects about 4,600 GW of new renewable capacity from 2025 to 2030 (about twice 2019–2024), about 80% of it solar, but still short of COP28's goal of tripling capacity by 2030.
2026 年能源冲击：2026 年 2 月底中东爆发涉及伊朗的军事冲突，霍尔木兹: The 2026 energy shock: a military conflict involving Iran broke out in the Middle East at the end of February 2026, and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz was badly disrupted from 4 March. It was declared open for a time during the April ceasefire, but exports through the strait were still disrupted in August. Brent passed US$110 a barrel at one point. The IEA called it the largest supply disruption in the oil market's history, and its August report expects 2026 global oil demand to fall about 1.56 million barrels a day to about 103.3 million, and supply to fall about 4.3 million barrels a day.
气候政策现状：欧盟 2026 年 3 月正式通过 2040 年温室气体净排放较: Climate policy now: in March 2026 the EU formally adopted a legal 2040 target of cutting net greenhouse gases 90% from 1990 (with up to 5 points from international credits from 2036), and delayed its second carbon market (ETS2), covering buildings and road fuel, to 2028. China's 2035 pledge is to cut economy-wide net greenhouse gases 7–10% from peak, with non-fossil energy at 30% of consumption, and its national carbon market plans absolute caps on some sectors from 2027. The US has left the Paris Agreement, and in January 2026 announced it would leave the UN climate convention. COP30 called for at least tripling adaptation finance by 2035.
据斯坦福《AI 指数报告 2026》，2025 年全球企业 AI 投资约 581: According to Stanford's AI Index Report 2026, global corporate AI investment was about US$581.7 billion in 2025, up about 130% on 2024. Private investment was about US$344.7 billion (up 127.5%), with generative AI firms getting about US$170.9 billion. It is highly concentrated: US private AI investment of about US$285.9 billion is 23 times China's (about US$12.4 billion), though this measure understates Chinese government guidance funds (estimated at about US$184 billion from 2000 to 2023).
AI 采用速度快于以往的通用技术：2025 年 88% 的受访组织使用 AI，7: AI is being adopted faster than earlier general-purpose technologies. In 2025, 88% of surveyed organisations used AI and 70% used generative AI in at least one function, but AI agent deployment stayed in single digits in almost all functions. Generative AI reached about 53% population-level adoption within three years, faster than PCs and the internet, with wide national differences (such as about 64% in the UAE and about 61% in Singapore). US consumer surplus from generative AI is estimated at about US$172 billion a year in early 2026.
AI 对就业的影响已在局部显现但尚未体现在总体就业数据中：美国 22-25 岁软: AI's effect on jobs is showing locally but not yet in overall employment data. Employment of US software developers aged 22–25 is down nearly 20% from 2024, and about a third of surveyed organisations expect AI-related staff cuts within a year. In structured tasks such as customer service, software development and marketing, studies report productivity gains of about 14–15%, 26% and 50%, while macro evidence remains limited and inconsistent.
AI 暴露度估计：IMF（2024）认为全球约 40% 的就业暴露于 AI，发达: AI exposure estimates: the IMF (2024) finds about 40% of global jobs exposed to AI, about 60% in advanced economies. The ILO (2025) estimates about a quarter of jobs worldwide have generative AI exposure, only 3.3% at the highest level, with high-income countries (34%) about three times low-income ones (11%). Exposure isn't job loss, and shows more as changes in what the work involves.
自动化潜力估计：麦肯锡全球研究院（2025）认为现有技术在理论上可自动化约 57: Automation potential estimates: the McKinsey Global Institute (2025) finds current technology could in theory automate about 57% of US work hours (software agents about 44%, robots about 13%), a technical potential rather than a job loss forecast. McKinsey (2023) estimates half of today's work activities could be automated between 2030 and 2060, with a midpoint around 2045. The World Economic Forum (2025) expects about 170 million jobs added and about 92 million lost from 2025 to 2030, with about 39% of workers' core skills changing.
专家预测：2023 年对 2778 名 AI 研究者的调查（Grace 等, 2: Expert forecasts: a 2023 survey of 2,778 AI researchers (Grace et al., 2024) put a 10% chance on "unaided machines outperforming humans in every task" by 2027 and 50% by 2047 (13 years earlier than the 2022 survey). The 50% date for "full automation of all occupations" is 2116.
能力增长趋势：Epoch AI 估计前沿 AI 模型训练算力每年增长约 4-5: Capability trends: Epoch AI estimates compute for training frontier AI models grows about 4–5 times a year. The International AI Safety Report 2026 notes the length of tasks AI agents can complete unsupervised doubles about every 7 months, while safety measures lag behind capability.
The IEA estimates global data centres used about 415 TWh in 2024 (about 1.5% of world power), with the US at 45%, China 25% and Europe 15%. In its base case this rises to about 945 TWh in 2030 and about 1,200 TWh in 2035, with AI the main driver.
工业机器人：2024 年全球新装工业机器人约 54.2 万台（与上年基本持平），: Industrial robots: about 542,000 were newly installed worldwide in 2024 (about flat on the year before), with an operational stock of about 4.664 million (4.282 million in 2023) and China taking 54% of new installations. Manufacturing robot density (per 10,000 employees): global average 132, South Korea 1,220, Singapore 818, Germany 449, Japan 446, US 307, China 166 (on updated labour data for China).
人形机器人仍处于起步阶段：Omdia 估计 2025 年全球出货约 1.3 万台: Humanoid robots are still at an early stage. Omdia estimates about 13,000 shipped worldwide in 2025, led by Chinese firms. Unitree says it delivered over 5,500 to end customers in 2025 (above Omdia's earlier estimate of about 4,200). Morgan Stanley forecasts faster spread in the late 2030s, with about a billion in use by 2050.
无人驾驶出租车已进入规模化运营初期：Waymo 2026 年上半年在美国 10: Driverless taxis have entered the early stage of operating at scale. In the first half of 2026 Waymo ran about 500,000 paid trips a week in 10 US cities, with a fleet of about 3,000–3,500 and over 20 million trips in total. Baidu's Apollo Go peaked at over 300,000 weekly orders in the fourth quarter of 2025, with over 20 million trips worldwide by February 2026, covering 26 cities.
电动车：IEA《全球电动汽车展望 2026》显示 2025 年全球电动车销量增长: Electric cars: the IEA's Global EV Outlook 2026 shows global sales up about 20% in 2025 to over 20 million, about a quarter of new cars, nearly 55% in China and about 28% in Europe. Of over 100 countries where EV sales grew, about a third have reached a share of 10% or more. The IEA expects about 23 million sales in 2026, about 28%.
计算与神经技术：谷歌 2024 年 Willow 芯片（105 个量子比特）首次: Computing and neurotechnology: Google's 2024 Willow chip (105 qubits) first showed "below threshold" quantum error correction, and IBM plans a fault-tolerant quantum computer with about 200 logical qubits by 2029. China's National Medical Products Administration approved the first implantable brain-computer interface product on 13 March 2026, and Neuralink had 21 participants by January 2026.
国际电联估计 2025 年全球约 60 亿人上网（约占世界人口四分之三），仍有约: The ITU estimates about 6 billion people were online worldwide in 2025 (about three quarters of world population), with about 2.2 billion still offline, the vast majority in low- and middle-income countries. In about 60% of low- and middle-income countries, internet access is still unaffordable.
抗微生物药物耐药（AMR）：GBD 研究（《柳叶刀》2024）估计 2021 年: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR): the GBD study (The Lancet, 2024) estimates bacterial resistance directly caused about 1.14 million deaths in 2021, with about 4.71 million associated. In the reference scenario direct deaths reach about 1.91 million and associated deaths about 8.22 million in 2050, with about 39 million direct deaths from 2025 to 2050. The World Bank (2017) estimates a high-resistance scenario may cut global GDP by 1.1–3.8% by 2050.
GLP-1 类药物迅速普及：KFF 2025 年 11 月调查显示约 12% 的: GLP-1 drugs spread rapidly. A KFF survey in November 2025 shows about 12% of US adults using them and 18% having used them. The WHO issued its first global guideline on GLP-1 treatment for obesity in December 2025 (a conditional recommendation). The US FDA approved the oral small-molecule GLP-1 orforglipron on 1 April 2026. Semaglutide patents expire from 2026 in India, China, Canada, Brazil and elsewhere, and after Indian generics launched the monthly cost fell to about ₹1,300–4,200.
新型疗法进入临床：默沙东与 Moderna 于 2026 年 8 月宣布个体化: New therapies are entering the clinic. In August 2026 Merck and Moderna announced that a Phase III trial of a personalised mRNA cancer vaccine with immunotherapy (1,137 high-risk melanoma patients after surgery) met its primary endpoint of recurrence-free survival, the first positive Phase III result for an mRNA cancer therapy. The CRISPR gene-editing therapy Casgevy has been approved for sickle cell disease and beta thalassaemia since 2023, extended to ages 2 and up in the US in July 2026. In 2025 the first in vivo base-editing treatment custom-made for a single child was published.
神经退行性疾病：WHO 估计 2021 年全球约 5700 万人患痴呆症，每年新: Neurodegenerative disease: the WHO estimates about 57 million people had dementia worldwide in 2021, with nearly 10 million new cases a year, the seventh leading cause of death. A 2021 WHO report projects about 78 million in 2030 and 139 million in 2050. The US FDA has approved lecanemab (full approval in 2023) and donanemab (2024), and in 2025 the first blood test to aid diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease.
传染病负担：WHO《世界疟疾报告 2025》估计 2024 年约 2.82 亿疟: Infectious disease burden: the WHO's World Malaria Report 2025 estimates about 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths in 2024, with the African region at 94% of cases and 95% of deaths, and antimalarial resistance confirmed or suspected in at least 8 African countries. By July 2025 the WHO had certified 47 countries and 1 territory malaria-free. About 10.7 million people had tuberculosis in 2024, and 1.23 million died.
HIV 预防：WHO 于 2025 年将每年注射两次的长效药物来那帕韦纳入 HI: HIV prevention: in 2025 the WHO added the twice-yearly long-acting injection lenacapavir to its guidelines for pre-exposure prevention. The maker and the Global Fund reached a deal to supply about 2 million people in low- and lower-middle-income countries over three years, and the first doses reached Eswatini and Zambia in November 2025.
精神健康与社会联系：WHO 2025 年报告估计全球超过 10 亿人患有精神健康: Mental health and social connection: a 2025 WHO report estimates over a billion people have mental health conditions (about 14% of the 2021 population), about 727,000 died by suicide in 2021, depression and anxiety cost about US$1 trillion a year, and median government mental health spending is about 2% of health budgets. The WHO Commission on Social Connection estimates about one in six people feel lonely, with loneliness linked to over 871,000 deaths a year.
大流行防范：WHO 成员国于 2025 年通过《大流行协定》，但其开放签署取决于: Pandemic preparedness: WHO members adopted the Pandemic Agreement in 2025, but its opening for signature depends on a Pathogen Access and Benefit Sharing (PABS) annex. On 1 May 2026 the intergovernmental working group agreed to extend the PABS talks (subject to World Health Assembly approval), with results to go to the 80th Assembly in May 2027 or a special session in 2026. H5N1 bird flu keeps spreading among animals and causing sporadic human cases, and the WHO assesses no sustained human-to-human spread so far and low public risk. The WHO counts 1,003 human cases worldwide from January 2003 to 6 September 2026, with 479 deaths.
大流行频率参考：Marani 等（2021）基于 1600 年以来的疫情数据估计: Pandemic frequency for reference: Marani et al. (2021), using outbreak data since 1600, estimate an epidemic of COVID's intensity recurs about every 59 years on average (uncorrected), with about a 38% chance in a lifetime, which may double if new diseases emerge faster. The WHO estimates about 14.9 million excess deaths linked to COVID in 2020–2021. The WHO declared 8 "public health emergencies of international concern" from 2009 to 2024.
乌普萨拉冲突数据项目（UCDP）：2025 年有组织暴力致死约 24.46 万人: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP): organised violence killed about 244,600 in 2025 (about 187,000 in 2024), the second highest since 1994 (after 2022). State-based armed conflicts reached 65, a record since 1946, across 35 countries. Interstate conflicts doubled for the second year running (8). One-sided violence against civilians killed about 76,500, the highest since 1994, mainly in Sudan.
军费与军控：SIPRI 估计 2025 年全球军费约 2.89 万亿美元，实际增: Military spending and arms control: SIPRI estimates global military spending of about US$2.89 trillion in 2025, up 2.9% in real terms, the 11th straight rise, at about 2.5% of world GDP (the highest since 2009), with Europe up 14% to about US$864 billion. NATO's 2025 Hague summit pledged 5% of GDP for defence and related security by 2035 (3.5% core defence). SIPRI estimates about 12,187 nuclear warheads worldwide in January 2026, about 9,745 in military stockpiles (about 130 more than a year earlier). The US-Russia New START treaty expired on 5 February 2026, leaving the two with no binding limit on strategic nuclear forces for the first time in over fifty years.
截至 2026 年 10 月仍在进行的主要冲突：俄乌战争（2022 年 2 月起: Major conflicts still under way as of October 2026: the Russia-Ukraine war (since February 2022) goes on, with US-brokered talks planned to resume in November 2026 at the earliest and no full ceasefire yet. On 28 February 2026 the US and Israel struck Iran, and Iran then struck targets in several Gulf states and Israel and in effect closed the Strait of Hormuz. A two-week ceasefire began on 7 April and a provisional memorandum was reached through Pakistan on 14 June, but the core disputes over the nuclear program, shipping and sanctions remain and attacks on ships continue. Gaza's October 2025 ceasefire holds in name, but strikes keep coming. Sudan's civil war (since April 2023), Myanmar's civil war (since 2021), the conflict in eastern DR Congo and armed conflict in the Sahel go on. The US also took military action against Venezuela in January 2026.
能源咽喉：霍尔木兹海峡承载约五分之一的全球石油消费量。2026 年海峡实际关闭后: Energy chokepoints: the Strait of Hormuz carries about a fifth of global oil consumption. After it was in effect closed in 2026, Brent passed US$100 a barrel for the first time since August 2022, and IEA members coordinated a release of 400 million barrels of strategic reserves, the largest ever.
冲突与碎片化的经济代价：世界银行等机构评估截至 2024 年底乌克兰未来十年重建: The economic cost of conflict and fragmentation: the World Bank and others assess Ukraine's reconstruction and recovery needs over the next decade at about US$524 billion as of the end of 2024. The UN, EU and World Bank assessed Gaza's needs at about US$53 billion in 2025. The IMF (2023) estimates long-run output losses from trade fragmentation at 0.2% to 7% of world GDP.
航天活动创纪录：2025 年全球进行约 324 次轨道发射尝试，其中 Space: Record space activity: about 324 orbital launch attempts were made worldwide in 2025, about 165 by SpaceX, and Starlink satellites in orbit passed 10,000 in 2026.
重返月球：阿尔忒弥斯 2 号于 2026 年 4 月 1 日发射、4 月 10: Returning to the Moon: Artemis II launched on 1 April 2026 and splashed down on 10 April (US local time), the first crewed lunar flyby in over 50 years. In 2026 NASA changed Artemis III to a docking test in low Earth orbit (with a target of late 2027 set in May), planning a landing with Artemis IV in 2028. China plans a crewed landing before 2030. It completed a low-altitude Long March 10 flight and Mengzhou abort test in February 2026, plans the basic form of its international lunar research station by 2035, and plans to launch Tianwen-3 in 2028 and return Mars samples in 2031. India plans its first space station module in 2028, a station by 2035 and a crewed landing by 2040.
日常生活数字化：世界银行《全球普惠金融指数 2025》显示 2024 年全球 7: Daily life goes digital: the World Bank's Global Findex 2025 shows 79% of adults worldwide had financial accounts in 2024. About a quarter of paid work days among Americans aged 20–64 were worked from home in 2025. A 2025 Common Sense Media survey shows nearly three quarters of US teens have used AI companion apps, about half regularly.
